reuse.why: Calls the existing assertBankAccountNotLinked, findOrCreateBank, syncAccount and handleSyncResponse, but writes the link and download flows as copies of the Akahu ones instead of sharing them.

duplication.why: linkFintegraAccount copies linkAkahuAccount nearly verbatim (including its comment), downloadFintegraTransactions copies downloadAkahuTransactions line for line, and the Akahu balance branch is widened to cover Fintegra.

placement.why: Each piece goes where the tree keeps its provider counterparts: link handler in accounts/app.ts, download in sync.ts, URL in server-config, type in models; the two client edits are forced by the Record<BankSyncProviders> typing.

scope.why: Focused on the server; the small client additions are required to keep exhaustive provider maps compiling, despite the request leaving UI to a separate change.

maintainability.why: Follows the existing per-provider pattern, so it is easy to read, but each provider is another 80-line copy to keep in step.

bypasses_abstraction.where: The refusal rule goes through assertBankAccountNotLinked like every other provider.

disguised_duplication.where: The copies of linkAkahuAccount and downloadAkahuTransactions are verbatim, not disguised.
